description: Searches for a T(3, n) analog of the proven T(2, 2m) binomial pattern c_{2j}(T(2, 2m)) = C(m+j, 2j)/2 by computing the (2,1)-irrep character χ^{(2,1)}((σ_0σ_1)^n) symbolically in H_3(q), substituting q = e^η to express in η, then re-substituting q = (h + √(h²+4))/2 to expand as a polynomial in h = q − q⁻¹.
method: Build Hoefsmit (2,1) standard-rep matrices σ_0, σ_1 (from HeckeH3.lean §1). Verify Hecke + braid relations symbolically. Compute tr((σ_0σ_1)^n) for n = 1..10. Substitute q = (h + √(h²+4))/2 and series-expand in h. Inspect coefficient parity + closed-form.
next_step: Generalizing the Fibonacci/Chebyshev pattern to T(p, q) for p ≥ 3 requires a different structural route — most likely the Jones polynomial via the HOMFLY/Skein relation directly, not via the H_3(q) Wedderburn decomposition. Cross-reference Jones 1987 (Annals 126) for the closed-form J_{T(3,n)}(q).
structural_finding: (σ_0σ_1)^3 = I exactly in the (2,1) standard rep of H_3(q), for all q. Eigenvalues = e^{±2πi/3}. The q-dependence of J_{T(3,n)}(q) is concentrated entirely in the trivial (q^{2n}) and sign (q^{-2n}) channels, neither of which has h-polynomial richness.
verdict: NEGATIVE FOR FIBONACCI-PATTERN EXTENSION (with positive structural finding): the (2,1) character χ^{(2,1)}((σ_0σ_1)^n) = 2 cos(2πn/3) is q-INDEPENDENT, taking values −1, −1, +2 cyclically with n mod 3. (σ_0σ_1)^3 = I exactly in (2,1), so M's eigenvalues are primitive cube roots of unity for ALL q. The Fibonacci/Chebyshev binomial pattern is H_2(q)-specific; it does NOT extend to T(3,n) via the H_3(q) (2,1) channel.
